steps.name: privacy-first-identity-contract
steps.summary: Defined the single-phase plan for privacy-first user identity: optional displayName profile only, no stored email/email hash/locale/timezone, displayName-based merchant invitations resolved to userId, provider-subject OAuth identity without email matching, soft unlink safety, and contract/docs/Postman verification.

steps.name: profile-and-invitation-contract-tests
steps.summary: Updated contract tests for privacy-first user profiles and merchant invitations. Tests now require displayName-only optional UserProfile data, no email/email hash/locale/timezone storage or API payloads, GET/PATCH /auth/me/profile route coverage, targetDisplayName invitation resolution to targetUserId, and targetEmail rejection.

steps.name: profile-and-invitation-implementation
steps.summary: Implemented displayName-only UserProfile domain/application/API/Postgres persistence, optional displayName creation and clearing, current profile GET/PATCH route registration, merchant targetDisplayName resolution through active user profiles, and removal of stored targetEmail from invitation domain/service/repository/schema.

steps.name: oauth-identity-unlink-contract
steps.summary: Added auth_oauth_identities schema contract keyed by provider and provider_subject with active provider-subject uniqueness, linked user/wallet references, linked_at/revoked_at soft revoke fields, and no email/email_hash columns. Documented that OAuth identity does not use email matching and unlink must preserve active login/payment safety.

steps.name: docs-postman-and-verification
steps.summary: Updated API/DOMAIN/README docs, route manifest count from 47 to 49, Postman collection/environment/expected route fixtures for /auth/me/profile and displayName merchant invitations, and verified the full scripts test suite plus phase validation.
